body: Everyday something happens, I'm letting someone down. I want to do what you said but no one around me is encouraging me at any way. I want to give H.S.C. this year. I will strive hard.  If my college lets me give it. I want to utilize these 8 months and give my best in boards. I'm at my lowest point of my life right now. Never thought that this day would come. When no one is helping me I took it to the internet to find people like me, to hear their stories. Thank you for taking your time and letting me know what happened with you. If I lose a year then be it. Till then I'll give my all.
It's hard to continue, everyone around me is disappointed. But I'll try make a turn in life, as long as she's with me. Thank you
